Landfall & High-Risk Zones: The system is moving towards the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, putting coastal and low-lying districts on maximum alert.   Godzilla El Nino Impact: Meteorological experts analyze how shifting global climatic patterns, including the active Godzilla El Nino phase, are influencing extreme weather anomalies, ocean heat anomalies, and erratic storm behaviors.
